observations: Photos show a removed vehicle drivetrain/gearbox assembly on the ground (no vehicle attached).
Large transmission case with attached components and wiring/hoses visible; appears to be an automatic transmission assembly.
A transfer case/4x4-related housing is visible near the transmission area (suggesting 4WD drivetrain components).
No readable brand/model plate, no visible part number, and no clear label/ID on the gearbox/transfer case in the photos.
Seller text claims Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 2011 and 4X4, but photos do not show the vehicle ID or matching tag.

claims.evidence: Photos show a transmission/transfer-case assembly but no readable Jeep/part-number/vehicle-year tag to confirm compatibility.
No odometer/vehicle history, no auction sheet, and no readable ID in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type or wrong Jeep Wrangler variant (3.6L vs other engines; 4x4 transfer case variant) leading to non-fitment.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission/transfer-case ID tag or stamped part number (close-up, readable) plus the VIN/engine code of the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not guaranteed to fit (treated like incompatible/unknown-spec).

risks.risk: Condition unknown: could be damaged internally (slipping, delayed engagement, metal debris) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being tested (bench test) showing forward/reverse engagement and no abnormal noises, or a short diagnostic scan report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete assembly (sensors, solenoids, cooler lines, mounting brackets, torque converter, linkage).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo of all included components and a photo of both ends/connection points showing nothing missing.

risks.risk: Transfer case/4x4 system issues (actuator, chain wear, leaks) that photos cannot confirm.
risks.proof: Photo of the transfer case tag/part number and a test video engaging 4H/4L (or at least actuator operation) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: 4x4 may not work.

risks.risk: Leakage or cracked housings not obvious from these angles (oil seepage, housing cracks).
risks.proof: Clean the unit and provide photos of all seams/ports plus a short leak test video (or confirmation of dry condition after cleaning).

proof_requests: Close-up, readable photos of the transmission and transfer-case ID tags/stamped part numbers (both units).
Donor vehicle details: VIN (or at least engine code) and confirmation of 3.6L + year + 4x4 system variant.
Bench test video showing gear engagement (forward/reverse) and any 4H/4L operation if included.
Photos showing all included parts (sensors, wiring connectors, cooler lines, mounting brackets) and confirmation nothing is missing.
response.reason: The photos show a transmission/4x4 drivetrain assembly, but the exact model/compatibility and working condition cannot be confirmed from readable identifiers or test evidence. To price safely, we need the ID tags/part numbers and proof of operation.
